title: #274 Free Health Services
prompt: Some countries have free health services. However, some people claim that those who live unhealthy lives should not receive free health services. Do you agree or disagree with this statement?

promptSegments.text: Some countries have free health services.
However, some people claim that those who live unhealthy lives should not receive free health services.
Do you agree or disagree with this statement?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Free health services ensure that poor people can receive necessary treatment, preventing them from becoming very sick and allowing them to work.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Free health services ensure that poor people can receive necessary treatment, preventing them from becoming very sick and allowing them to work.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, free health services encourage people to adopt better habits, such as eating good food, by providing advice when they are ill.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, free health services encourage people to adopt better habits, such as eating good food, by providing advice when they are ill.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Free health services are necessary for all people, regardless of their personal habits.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Free health services are necessary for all people, regardless of their personal habits.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Free health services help people adopt better habits and lead healthier lives.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Free health services help people adopt better habits and lead healthier lives.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: People who make poor lifestyle choices should bear some responsibility for their own health, as the public health system must spend a lot of money on preventable problems.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: People who make poor lifestyle choices should bear some responsibility for their own health, as the public health system must spend a lot of money on preventable problems.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Free services can encourage people to ignore their own health habits, leading to minor issues becoming major problems for the whole community.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Free services can encourage people to ignore their own health habits, leading to minor issues becoming major problems for the whole community.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that free health services are necessary for everyone, regardless of their personal lifestyle choices.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that free health services are necessary for everyone, regardless of their personal lifestyle choices.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay emphasizes that denying care based on lifestyle is harmful to the community and the overall public health system.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay emphasizes that denying care based on lifestyle is harmful to the community and the overall public health system.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

modelPlan.focus: Discuss whether individuals with unhealthy lifestyles should receive free health services, considering the implications for public health and individual responsibility.
keyArguments: Free health services should be available to all, regardless of lifestyle choices, to ensure equitable access to healthcare.
Individual responsibility for health should be encouraged through education and prevention, rather than denying access to care.
